text: This report provides a second brief update on the actions taken by staff with regard to the selection of investment managers since the last meeting of the Toronto Investment Board on September 6, 2018.

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Directed that the information contained in the Revised Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 7, 2018) from the Executive Director, Corporate Finance remain confidential in its entirety as it pertains to financial information, supplied in confidence to the Toronto Investment Board, involving the security of property belonging to the City or one of its agencies or corporations.
